title: Bounded local-memory32-adding rho with disclosed hash and collision heuristics

claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 pairing inversion target,the algorithm in proof.md has success at least0.49 under the explicitly disclosed and supported H1 hash-pseudorandomness and H2 mean-first-repeat heuristics. Its deterministic total cold computation,including every cutoff/sampling/denominator failure,preprocessing,SHA evaluation,pairing,output and verification,is at most2^136 dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at fixed C=20000. Peak memory<2^30 bytes,preprocessing below2^136 equivalents is included,and advice is zero. All accesses are local64-bit addresses. This is a heuristic exploratory upper bound,not an unconditional production success proof.

experiments.purpose: Check bounded32-adding Floyd recurrence,recovery,invariants and actual first-repeat statistics in small safe-prime subgroups; audit dictionary is toy-only. Does not certify BLS mixing,hash idealization,or production instruction prices.
